card.name: Qur in Qur'an, plus 'sort' and 'though'
card.fires_on: Mainly the first piece of the word Qur'an right after 'the' when a text cites scripture. It also fires weakly on a few words like 'sort' in 'what sort of' and 'though' in 'as though'.

modes.label: Qur in Qur'an
modes.description: The opening piece of Qur'an after 'in the' or 'from the' when scripture is cited.
modes.example: such as those mentioned in the<< Qur>>’a n and Hadith.

modes.label: 'sort' after 'what'
modes.description: The word sort in the question phrase 'what sort of', followed by a topic.
modes.example: What<< sort>> of complications might arise?

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Scattered connecting words such as 'though' after 'as' or 'particularly' after a comma.
modes.example: they look overwhelmingly as<< though>> they’re designed.
